label: Cave System
summary: The game's caves under a relief — chambers, tunnels, noodles, ravines, aquifers and a lava floor — with lush caves under wet ground, deep dark under the mountains and dripstone caves between.

inputs.name: height
inputs.label: Height
inputs.help: The relief over the caves: its wet hollows take lush caves, its mountains deep dark under them.

inputs.name: area
inputs.label: Area
inputs.help: Where the caves go; everywhere when left empty.

exposed.name: seed
exposed.label: Seed
exposed.help: Another seed gives other caves of the same kind.

exposed.name: chambers
exposed.label: Chambers
exposed.help: How much of the rock the large chambers take.

exposed.name: size
exposed.label: Size
exposed.help: How large the chambers and tunnels are (1: as the game carves them).

exposed.name: low
exposed.label: Lowest
exposed.help: The lowest height the caves reach, in blocks.

exposed.name: high
exposed.label: Highest
exposed.help: The highest height tunnels reach; the roof keeps them under the ground.

exposed.name: entrances
exposed.label: Surface entrances
exposed.help: The share of the land where caves open to the sky.

exposed.name: aquifers
exposed.label: Aquifers
exposed.help: Water and lava lakes at their own levels, sealed by walls of rock.

exposed.name: flooded
exposed.label: Flooded share
exposed.help: The share of the rock's zones holding water or lava.

exposed.name: lava
exposed.label: Lava share
exposed.help: The share of the deep flooded zones holding lava.

exposed.name: lava_floor
exposed.label: Lava floor height
exposed.help: Caves under this height are full of lava.

exposed.name: lush
exposed.label: Lush caves
exposed.help: How much of the wet ground has lush caves under it.

exposed.name: dripstone
exposed.label: Dripstone caves
exposed.help: How much of the rock between holds dripstone caves.

exposed.name: deep_dark
exposed.label: Deep dark
exposed.help: How much of the ground under the mountains has the deep dark far below.

exposed.name: mountains
exposed.label: Mountains from
exposed.help: The height above which the ground counts as mountains, in blocks.
